blocks.text:
Photos taken with a Casio camera watch: 120x120 pixels, 16 shades of grey. Every photo is a window on this desktop. Drag them, stretch them, pile them up.

Open gallery.exe to see them all, glitch.exe to break one, and share.exe to see what other visitors made.

cam.text:
In 2000 Casio put a camera inside a wristwatch: the WQV‑1, the first watch in the world with a built-in digital camera.

Its tiny sensor takes pictures of 120 by 120 pixels in 16 shades of grey, and you frame them on the watch's own screen.
